messages:
anna: Heads-up: planning a non-prod dry-run deploy tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC across API, runtime, console, router. Main goals: validate header-pin behavior, model variant pin, and rollback triggers. Any red flags?

liam: Sounds good. Can we pin runtime to quant-v2-2024-11 for the canary shards? We saw variance in latency last week.

kevin: Agree on pin. Router requires explicit header routing change to test the new console path. I'll prepare the rule but won't activate until deploybot signals.

ui_prod: Console note: schema compatibility check passed in staging, but there is a minor telemetry key change. We'll gate the telemetry and keep UI toggle off by default.

sre_oncall: SRE items: add an early abort condition if token-level error rate > 0.8% over 3m. Also add a metric for runtime kv-cache-miss rate spike.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled by @anna for 2024-11-29T23:00:00Z. Canary: 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate_delta > 0.8% OR p95_rt > 300ms for 4m. Dry-run mode will stop before 100%. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dryrun-vm-shim

anna: Thanks. Kevin, please include the header pin command in the preflight but mark it manual. Example:

```
rbctl set-route --env=canary --header X-NewConsole=1 --target=canary-variant
```

kevin: Will do. Also adding a rollback hedge: keep old router rule cached for 10m after switch to allow fast flip.

liam: Runtime ops: we'll run the pinned variant on 2 shards only for the first wave and enable detailed traces for those shards. Command:

```
runtimectl pin --variant=quant-v2-2024-11 --shards=shard-02,shard-03
```

ui_prod: Console rollout: deploy -> smoke with 8 internal users -> hold -> 20% wave. We'll not auto-progress without ack from console owner.

sre_oncall: Monitoring config I'll add:
- alert: canary_error_rate_high -> threshold 0.8% over 3m
- alert: runtime_p95_spike -> baseline + 45% over 4m
- dashboard: cross-service traces for header path

anna: Release notes stub I'll draft: "Dry-run: test header routing and model variant pin; no customer-visible changes. Rollback criteria attached." Tagging @product for visibility.

kevin: Minor caveat: some older SDK clients may send legacy header case. I'll enable compat shim toggled by flag post-final-wave for 2 hours.

liam: Add KV eviction plan after the final canary wave to avoid stale cache:

```
runtimectl kv-evict --regex="^session_prefix:" --delay=45s
```

ui_prod: We'll watch UI error logs: if any 5xxs > 0.3% we hold.

sre_oncall: I'll be on-call and will run the abort sequence if alerts fire. Abort sequence: pause traffic -> rollback runtime pin -> revert router rule -> notify channels.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks passed. Dry-run will stop after 60% wave. Executing first wave at 23:00 UTC.

anna: Final preflight sync at 22:30 UTC. If nobody raises blockers, proceed.

kevin: I'll be online for the header flip and rollback if needed.

liam: Keeping an eye on traces, ready to trigger rollback.

ui_prod: :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: :white_check_mark:
